purpose: Which model each agent runs on. Change a tier by editing one line here; no code change is needed. Decision record: docs/decisions/2026-11-18-model-tiers.md.

fundamental_analyst.note: Largest reader of text. Check its findings by hand against the filings for three tickers; move to the fallback if it misreads. Keep every prompt under 100,000 tokens: above that Haiku is billed at five times the rate.

critic.note: Same model family as the thesis agent for the demo, stated on the challenge screen. A different family remains the aim.

embedding.note: Chosen 19 November 2026 (pre-approved by the operator). Runs on the Mac with no key; downloaded once (79 MB) from chroma-onnx-models.s3.amazonaws.com into data/embedding-model. The index is built by `python -m tradecraft.research build` into data/research-index. If it cannot be opened, keyword search over the same passages is used and recorded. Claude offers no embedding model.

not_models: the validation check on a draft
restating the thesis as a question

prices_usd_per_million_tokens.source: Anthropic first-party list prices as cached in the claude-api reference on 2026-11-03; check the pricing page before relying on them for anything but the spend stops

claude-haiku-5-5.note: cache_read and cache_write for Haiku are assumed at 0.1x and 1.25x of input; not confirmed

rate_limits.source: operator, from the Anthropic Console, 18 November 2026
rate_limits.note: Organization limits per model. Far above what one request needs (about 120,000 tokens read and 10,000 written per run), so the three analysts run in parallel and the stage 2 time limit stays at 5 minutes. The harness still retries a rate-limit error twice with an increasing pause.

budget.basis: About 120,000 tokens read and 10,000 written per run; an estimate made on 18 November 2026 from published prices, to be replaced by measured usage.
